meta.title: Companies worth following
meta.note: Auto-tracked: the companies most active in the curated event log, each with its latest dated development. Machine-written from gated facts only; no hand-written copy.

companies.name: Pemex
companies.signal: Pemex and Brazil's Petrobras are negotiating a second agreement to deepen cooperation in refining, fuels, biofuels, and petrochemicals in Mexico. The deal would expand the companies' existing alliance to cover downstream operations.

companies.name: Kia
companies.signal: Kia's Pesquería plant in Mexico is projected to exceed 300,000 annual units by end of 2026, driven by a 649 million dollar investment to produce the all-electric EV3 compact SUV.

companies.name: TV Azteca
companies.signal: A USMCA tribunal rejected a 219 million dollar claim by Cyrus and Contrarian funds against Mexico, ruling the investors were not protected by the trade agreement. The decision spares Mexico from paying disputed bondholder claims.

companies.name: Mercado Libre
companies.signal: Mexico's strong performance lifted company-wide results in the quarter. Mercado Pago's expansion in payments processing and the buoyancy of digital commerce reflect sustained consumer spending and fintech adoption.

companies.name: Vulcan
companies.signal: The decision against Mexico in the investor-state dispute carries precedent for future claims and signals exposure under the trade agreement. Vulcan's public criticism indicates a pattern of tension over property rights and regulatory action.

companies.name: DiDi
companies.signal: DiDi is building out a green transport network in Mexico as part of broader adoption of electric vehicles in ride-hailing, signaling market shift toward cleaner mobility.
